source.title: Topologization of algebras. -- The results and open problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL with numeric record slug 1415132. No local PDF path was supplied.

Failure mode: metadata_only with blocked_or_challenged for the zbMATH HTML landing page. Direct zbMATH HTML fetching returned HTTP 403, while the zbMATH REST API was usable only as resolver metadata. The API identified W. Zelazko, 'Topologization of algebras. -- The results and open problems', Zbl 0948.46036, pages 42-46 in Pawan K. Jain (ed.), Functional Analysis. Selected topics, New Delhi: Narosa Publishing House, 1998, ISBN 81-7319-199-9. The API record exposed no full-text links and its review text was treated as metadata/review content, not as the technical source.

Bounded exact-work recovery used the zbMATH identifier, the exact title, the exact title plus PDF, the exact title plus the page range 42-46, and the book ISBN/title. Inspected candidates included Google Books, WorldCat, Open Library, Narosa catalog pages, Better World Books/Archive preview metadata, and references from later papers. These candidates were bibliographic records, catalog records, limited/no-preview book pages, citation references, or unrelated works; none was a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements.
No doc_map was produced because no readable primary source artifact was recovered. Metadata, reviews, tables of contents, catalog records, and search snippets were not used as technical source text.

No candidates were extracted because the source adequacy gate forbids extracting open problems from resolver metadata, bibliographic records, reviews, abstracts, search snippets, or catalog pages when the technical problem statements are not visible in a primary source.
Failed the source adequacy gate: no readable exact-work PDF or HTML full-text source was recovered within the bounded pass.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/1415132.json and outputs/latest.json.
